test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Who'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"who" **is used to refer to people.
 
• **In this context,** it is referring to the kids who are beginning to read all the way to those reading advanced chapter books.
 
• **It emphasizes **that the reading strategy suggestions below are intended for children, highlighting their active involvement in the reading process.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Children learn to walk and talk naturally, (1) but that is not the case with reading. Reading strategies are designed to help your child develop a strong reading (2) foundation one built with confidence engagement and joy. As a parent, you are most likely always looking for (3) techniques that make your child want to learn. We are here to help you and your child on their journey as a (4)budding reader. Try some reading strategy suggestions below for kids (5) **who** are beginning to read all the way to those reading advanced chapter books.*
